featured_reviews.name: Dilesh Umale
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Life-Changing Experience
I honestly don’t know where I’d be without Dr. Anjalika Atrey. When I first walked into her office, I was in a really dark place - severe health anxiety that had spiraled into heavy drinking and smoking. I couldn’t be alone, couldn’t leave the house, couldn’t do basic everyday things. I was barely functioning.
From day one, Dr. Anjalika was different. She didn’t rush me or make me feel judged. She just listened… really listened… to everything I was going through. Then she calmly explained what was happening with me in a way that actually made sense, and we started treatment right away.
Here’s the part that still blows my mind… within just 10 days, my health anxiety and panic attacks dropped by about 90%. Not just less frequent… less intense too. And the cravings for alcohol and cigarettes? Gone. I never thought that was possible, especially not that quickly.
Dr. Anjalika is more than just a skilled psychiatrist… she’s genuinely a gem of a person. She gave me my life back when I thought I’d lost it for good. I’m continuing treatment with her and I’ve already started recommending her to family and friends who are struggling with mental health or addiction issues.
If you’re suffering and thinking about reaching out, just do it. Best decision I’ve made.
